caps: *Kerala* was pulled | out of the *SEA*… | by ONE *AXE*.
lines.tts: Kerala was pulled out of the sea, by one axe.

caps: *Parshurama* had won the earth | from arrogant kings… | and given ALL of it away.
lines.tts: Parshuraama had won the earth from arrogant kings, and given all of it away.

caps: Sage *Kashyapa* told him: | “You can’t live on land | you have given away.”
lines.tts: Sage Kashyapa told him: you cannot live on land you have given away.

caps: The *Mahabharata* says | the *ocean* made new land for him.
lines.tts: The Mahabharata says, the ocean made new land for him.

caps: *Kerala’s* own legend tells how. | He stood at *Gokarna*…
lines.tts: Kerala's own legend tells how. He stood at Gokarna,

caps: …and prayed to *Varuna*, | the god of the sea.
lines.tts: and prayed to Varuna, the god of the sea.

caps: The *sea* drew back | as far as it flew…
lines.tts: The sea drew back, as far as it flew,

caps: That’s why Kerala is called | *Parashurama Kshetram*.
lines.tts: That is why Kerala is called, Parashuraama Kshetram.

caps: And *science*? | Kerala’s coastal plain | is *young* land.
lines.tts: And science? Kerala's coastal plain is young land.

caps: Thousands of years ago, | the *sea* came further inland.
lines.tts: Thousands of years ago, the sea came further inland.

caps: The *backwaters* began | as a bay of the sea, | shut in by sand bars.
lines.tts: The backwaters began as a bay of the sea, shut in by sand bars.
Kuttanaad is still farmed, below sea level.

caps: The legend says the sea *drew back*. | The land says so too.
lines.tts: The legend says the sea drew back. The land says so too.

caps: Which part of *Kerala* | are YOU from? | Tell us below!
lines.tts: Which part of Kerala are you from? Tell us below!
